red.candidate: Deliberately minimal experimental candidate set directory/file flags without a final identity/content recensus. This is not a reproduction of an existing production custody implementation; no such implementation exists.
failure_modes: new directory entry before fencing accepted
same bytes on replacement file inode accepted
existing writable descriptor changed content between directory and file fences without detection

cases: stable inventory fences both original inodes
new entry before directory fence refused
same bytes on replacement inode refused
existing FD content change after directory fence refused
full fence blocks preexisting writer and unlink
partial transition retains flags until explicit fixture cleanup
content change after first file fence refused by final recensus
actual inode owner UID1000 without capability cannot clear immutable
observed_algorithm: Capture names, device/inode identity, UID/link count/size and content digest plus held original readonly descriptions.
Set immutable on the held original directory. Recheck its current named identity, exact inventory and every original file description.
Set immutable on each held original regular file description. Recheck directory identity, inventory, content, held descriptions and all file flags.
Refuse any mismatch without automatic restriction rollback. Explicit test cleanup restores only its own allocated fixture flags.
limits: Controlled syscall interleavings, not complete arbitrary writer closure or a privileged host helper implementation. Namespace/inode replacements are controlled between capture and fence; content and post-fence access cases use actual subprocesses and inherited FDs.
No journal, fsync/crash durability, lost-response recovery, source/input authority, actual-host kernel qualification or all-consumer reservation implementation is established.
Deliberate mutation cases change their own disposable fixture contents to require refusal; production native bytes, aliases, outcomes, policies and reservations are unchanged.
Original pending owner-host probe bytes remain unchanged. No native/provider inference or new shipping/model allowance was used.
